clips.title: The story
paras: In the northwestern Barrens, Witchwing Talons mark dead harpy raiders. Horde scouts at the Crossroads seek them as proof while they work to secure vital caravan routes.

Witchwing harpies raid Horde supply caravans from their roosts northwest of the Crossroads. Scout Darsok Swiftdagger coordinates strikes against the flock's hierarchy. Darsok requires physical proof of each dead scavenger, and the talons provide it. With proof that raiders have fallen, the scouts can weaken the flock's ranks before striking higher in its command.
